answer: Epoch consistency scoring makes each identity keep a stable behavioral profile across epochs, with divergence from its own earlier task mix and timing lowering its routing priority. To recover, it must complete low-risk work such as opal settlement checks. Each fake identity must also carry a coherent comet-like activity trace across many epochs rather than appear only when rewards spike. The attacker pays per-identity epoch upkeep and delayed access while sustaining an orchard of separate long-lived histories, so fresh identities cannot cheaply replace restricted ones.
